title: MemSlides: A Hierarchical Memory Driven Agent Framework for Personalized Slide Generation with Multi-turn Local Revision
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Keeping a persistent user profile separate from the active edit limits carryover of one-off preferences. Test localization by changing one slide and diffing all untouched slides. Persona alignment and edit success were evaluated separately; working-memory carryover evidence was qualitative.

title: The Critical Role of Model Selection in Causal Inference: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Models within the InferBERT Framework for Pharmacovigilance
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: BioBERT leads the two reported classification comparisons. Calibration, predictive accuracy and concordance with existing signals measure different things; agreement with a signal detector cannot independently establish drug causality.

title: Models Take Notes at Prefill: KV Cache Can Be Editable and Composable
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: The cached state can encode derived conclusions beyond the changed field. Correctness testing must compare downstream decisions after an edit against full recomputation. The quoted latency depends on cache hits, serving workload and percentile; it is not a per-request guarantee.

title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Postselected fidelity and yield report different costs. At the reported retention rate, an accepted state needs about 12.5 attempts on average at constant acceptance probability. Compare resource cost per accepted state as well as its quality.

title: The Little Book of Generative AI Foundations: An Intuitive Mathematical Primer
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: A teaching resource organized around relationships among model families. Use its PCA-to-latent-model sequence for conceptual prerequisites; the abstract offers neither a benchmark result nor evidence about which architecture to deploy.

title: Language Diffusion Models are Associative Memories Capable of Retrieving Unseen Data
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: The experiment contrasts recovery of corrupted training and test examples as dataset size changes. Conditional entropy is proposed as a diagnostic; interpreting it as evidence of generalization needs validation for the same model family and corruption regime.

title: Self-Generated Error Training for Token Editing in Diffusion Language Models
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Training edits on the model’s own fluent mistakes addresses a different distribution from random vocabulary substitutions. Evaluate correctness and edit count together: fewer edits are desirable only if unresolved draft mistakes do not increase.

title: PromptMN: Pseudo Prompting Language
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Explicit role, input and output fields make an inferred brief inspectable before execution. Demonstrations that frontier models interpret directives show feasibility; estimating reduced rework would require matched tasks and measured repair cycles.

title: Diagnosing Shape-Prior Shortcuts in Long-Range Single-Shot Fringe Projection Profilometry
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: A featureless plane with valid fringes separates reliance on object outlines from depth decoding. Aggregate error on familiar shapes hides this shortcut. The reported evidence comes from a synthetic long-range benchmark; transfer to a physical instrument remains a separate question.

title: Data-Efficient Kernel Methods for Learning Differential Equations and Their Solution Operators: Algorithms and Error Analysis
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: The framework learns an equation before deriving a solution operator. Smoothness conditions govern propagation of error to the latter. Compare accuracy at matched numbers of observed states and samples per state before generalizing numerical gains.

title: Calibrating global behaviour of equation of state by combining nuclear and astrophysics inputs in a machine learning approach
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Symbolic surrogates accelerate repeated equation-of-state inference. Agreement of the reported posteriors is a more relevant validation than speed alone; changing observational priors or moving outside the fitted region would warrant a fresh solver comparison.

title: MODE: Modality-Decomposed Expert-Level Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE Multimodal LLMs
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Raw expert activation frequencies mix modality importance with sheer token counts. The proposed allocation splits those signals under a fixed bit budget. Report separate language and vision outcomes because an aggregate loss can conceal modality-specific degradation.

title: Community detection in complex networks via node similarity, graph representation learning, and hierarchical clustering
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: A hierarchy permits changing community count while preserving nesting, useful when the correct count is unknown. The comparison spans 364 pipeline combinations; time complexity limits the authors’ personal-machine use case to roughly ten thousand vertices.

title: Attention Is Not What You Need
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: An attention-free language model and a replacement head on DistilBERT are two different tests. The second retains a pretrained transformer backbone. Slight head-level gains on SNLI cannot establish that the whole model works without attention.

title: Probing, Fusion, and Trustworthiness: A Systematic Evaluation of Foundation Model Representations for Multimodal Cancer Analysis
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Fusion helps where image and omics signals complement each other. Evaluate conformal coverage together with set size: returning the true label within a broad set is different from producing an actionable single-label prediction. Evidence is confined to the evaluated cohorts.

title: Informative Missingness to Generate Irregular Clinical Time Series
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Modeling both values and whether a lab was ordered can preserve clinician-specific sampling behavior. Similar synthetic distributions under one hospital dataset do not establish clinical utility or transfer to a site with different ordering practices.

title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: The authors evaluate persistence after attempted relearning alongside retention of general abilities. A probability drop across the evaluated datasets is evidence about those tests, not proof that every trace of the target knowledge has been removed.

title: From Parasocial Scripts to Dyadic Persistence in Autonomous AI-Agent Communities
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Reciprocal language predicts repeat interaction in the observed posts. Treat this as a discourse pattern between accounts; textual recurrence cannot establish subjective attachment or the causal effect of a particular phrase.

title: Noise-Driven Escape from Metastable Phases explains Grokking in Deep Neural Networks
evidence_type: Author abstract; independently interpreted. Full paper and code not evaluated.
analysis: Manipulating trapping and noise in linear networks gives a controlled account of delayed generalization. The extension to nonlinear networks is presented as supporting evidence; the abstract does not establish a universal mechanism.
